Hi Lisa / Tom,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can line up a short product intro (30 minutes) and bring a couple technical folks if helpful.

Recap (high level)
- Primary objective: reduce inference latency for near-real-time clinical summarization and lower per-token cost for batch analytics.
- Constraints: HIPAA data flows, prefer private VPC deployment or dedicated capacity; need SOC2 evidence and an audit log retention window of at least 12 months.
- Success criteria: P95 latency under 350ms for 1k token summaries; predictable cost targets for monthly volume ~100M tokens.

Proposed 30-minute intro slots (all PT):
1) Tue Sep 1 — 10:00–10:30am PT
2) Wed Sep 2 — 11:30–12:00pm PT
3) Thu Sep 3 — 9:00–9:30am PT

Please tell me which option works best and who on your side should join (technical lead, security/compliance contact, procurement). If none of these work, reply with 2–3 times that do. I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

I’ve attached a brief discovery notes PDF and a draft 30m agenda. Monica (CS) is looped for post-demo readiness and Neha will handle commercial questions.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
